args.find:
- name: Report regenerated matrix drift (no push)
        run: |
          git add docs/venice-audit-v1
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo 'no matrix drift: generated outputs match the committed state'
          else
            echo 'matrix drift detected: generated outputs differ from the committed state'
            git diff --cached --stat
          fi
args.replace:
- name: Commit regenerated matrices when they drift
        run: |
          git rm -r --cached --quiet docs/venice-audit-v1/__pycache__ || true
          git add -A docs/venice-audit-v1
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo 'no matrix drift: generated outputs match the committed state'
            exit 0
          fi
          echo 'matrix drift detected: generated outputs differ from the committed state'
          git diff --cached --stat
          git config user.name 'venice-audit-bot'
          git config user.email 'venice-audit-bot@users.noreply.github.com'
          git commit -m 'chore(audit): regenerate v2 audit matrices from authority files'
          git push origin HEAD:venice/repo-hierarchical-audit-v2
          echo 'committed and pushed regenerated outputs; the next run on the pushed head is the merge-gate check'
